subject: Northpoint integration: escalated support timeline & coordination
messages:
From: Alex Hsu <alex.hsu@northpointanalytics.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: support@northpointanalytics.com
Date: 2026-11-29T16:08:00-08:00
Subject: Integration timeout spikes affecting sync windows

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from the field — over the last 24 hours our ingest job that reads Redwood webhooks has begun timing out intermittently when batches exceed ~12k tokens. It looks like the retry logic and backoff on our side is working, but customers see delayed indexing (30–90m). I attached the error trace I captured.

Can we get someone from your integrations/ops team to look at the request logs around 2026-11-29T02:30–05:00Z? We're trying to determine if this is rate-limiting at the gateway or a model instance-level queueing issue.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Integrations, Northpoint Analytics
---
Attachment: np_error_trace_20261129.txt (text/plain, 42KB)
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: alex.hsu@northpointanalytics.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration timeout spikes affecting sync windows

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the trace.

We're escalating this to our partner ops rotation. Quick plan:
- Marissa will pull the request logs and token-level latency breakdown for the window you flagged.
- Ben will validate whether any model fallback or bursting policy kicked in that could cause queue buildup.
- I'll own the partner communications and timeline.

Expect an initial triage update within 4 hours and a proposed mitigation runbook within 24 hours. If Northpoint can share a sample webhook payload size distribution, that will help us simulate in our staging cluster.

Kimberly Park
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
---
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T18:03:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Integration timeout spikes affecting sync windows

Quick update from triage: we see a cluster (us-west-2, model v3.2q) with sustained token service time increase from 02:10Z–04:50Z. No throttles at the API gateway level, but one node reported heavy KV cache misses once sequence lengths exceeded the 8k threshold. Attaching a short log excerpt in the runbook.

Immediate suggestions:
- Apply temporary rate smoothing on Northpoint's side (reduce concurrency by 15% for 2 hours) to allow KV cache warm-up.
- We'll schedule a short-canary rollout of a cache-warmup policy on a control pool (15 minutes) to validate.

Ben: can you confirm if fallback to the lower-capacity model variant would be safe for Northpoint's latency SLOs?

Marissa
Partner Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
---
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: alex.hsu@northpointanalytics.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration timeout spikes affecting sync windows

Alex / team — I spoke with Infra and the short answer: a temporary fallback to the v3.1-quant variant should keep 95p latency under your 2s per-token expectation for the bulk of requests, but quality regressions for long context excerpts are possible. If Northpoint values strict token-level fidelity for analytics extracts, we should avoid blind fallback.

Proposed coordinated mitigation (today):
1) Northpoint reduces concurrent webhook workers by 15% for a 2-hour window starting 2026-12-01T02:00Z.
2) Redwood enables cache-warmup policy on a control pool and monitors queue depth. If queue depth drops by >30% in 20 minutes, we proceed to roll the policy to your production pool.
3) If rollback is needed, Redwood will automatically failover to existing stable instances and notify.

I'll prepare a short runbook PDF and a Slack bridge for the execution window.

Ben Carter
Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood-northpoint-escalation-runbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 75KB)
From: Alex Hsu <alex.hsu@northpointanalytics.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: priya.shah@northpointanalytics.com, support@northpointanalytics.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration timeout spikes affecting sync windows — agreed plan

Thanks team — confirmed on Northpoint side. We'll enact the 15% concurrency reduction and standby for the canary window. Priya from our ops team will run the change and post updates to PARTNER-4123.

We have one ask before the window: can Redwood share the observability query (or dashboard link) you will watch so our on-call can see the same signals? Also, can you add a contact for after-hours pager escalation if the canary triggers a wider degradation?

Appreciate the rapid coordination — we'll look to close the ticket with a post-mortem and suggested long-term optimizations (batching changes on our side + a quantization profile test on Redwood).

—Alex
Head of Integrations, Northpoint Analytics
